headline: SILVER ABOVE $80, GOLD $4,706 AS US-IRAN CLASHES RENEW INFLATION FEARS
snippet: Silver surged 2.99% to $80.71/oz and gold held firm at $4,706.36 on May 8, as renewed US-Iran clashes reignited safe-haven and inflation-hedge demand; silver is now up 147% year-over-year against a sixth consecutive structural supply deficit projected at 67 million ounces.

headline: BONANZA GRADE: Silver47 Hits 38.7 g/t Au, 1,713 g/t Ag At Untapped 15km Nevada Vein System
snippet: Silver47 Exploration (TSX-V: AGA) reported rock samples grading up to 38.7 g/t gold and 1,713 g/t silver at its expanded Kennedy Gold-Silver Project in Nevada, where a ~15 km network of near-surface high-grade veins remains largely unexplored; ground geophysics and drill targeting are now underway.

headline: MANHATTAN URANIUM (TSX-V: MANU) Seals Rollup of 15 Past-Producing U.S. Uranium Mines
snippet: Formerly Aero Energy, Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. (TSX-V: MANU) completed court-approved acquisitions of Urano Energy and Pegasus Resources on May 7, assembling 15 past-producing uranium mines across 25,099 acres on 25 U.S. properties into a single North American pure-play uranium vehicle.

headline: SSR MINING JUMPS 20%: Near-$600M Q1 Revenue, 113K oz Gold, $1.5B Copler Sale On Track
snippet: SSR Mining (SSRM) surged 20% on May 6 after posting nearly $600 million in Q1 revenue, 113,000 gold-equivalent ounces sold, and $300 million in operating cash flow; its binding $1.5 billion sale of the Turkish Copler mine to Cengiz Holding is expected to close before end of Q3 2026.

headline: CFTC CHAIR: All 11 CME Silver Vaults Sit Within 150 Miles of NYC — A National Security Risk
snippet: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig endorsed the SILVER Act, warning that concentrating all 11 CME-approved silver depositories within 150 miles of New York City creates national security and market stability risks; the proposed legislation would direct the CFTC to promote geographic diversification of precious metals storage.

headline: COPPER CRUNCH: South America's Exploration Boom Can't Keep Pace With 150K-Tonne 2026 Shortfall
snippet: Copper trades near $13,000/mt with the ICSG forecasting a 150,000-tonne 2026 shortfall; Latin America attracts 46% of global copper exploration budgets but average discovery-to-production lead times of 17 years leave the market structurally exposed, and the IEA warns current mines will satisfy only 80% of 2030 demand.

headline: RARE EARTH RECKONING: NdPr Falls 21% in April But Still 88% Higher YTD as China Policy Holds Floor
snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide fell to $99.61/kg in April 2026 — its sharpest monthly correction since the Q1 rally — but remains up 88% year-to-date from January's $53/kg open; analysts project a $95-$115/kg consolidation range through Q2 as China's export controls maintain a structural price floor.

headline: CHILE LITHIUM SURGE: $498M in April Exports, Up 175% YoY as SQM-Codelco Partnership Ramps
snippet: Chile's lithium carbonate exports hit $498 million in April 2026, up 175.6% year-over-year, as the strategic SQM-Codelco partnership ramped first-quarter shipments 25% by volume; copper exports from Chile stalled in the same period amid sulphuric acid supply disruptions linked to the Iran conflict.

headline: FIVE JUNIORS BESIDE MAJORS: West Point Gold 22.9m @ 3.11 g/t, GoldMining 22 g/t High Grade
snippet: A May 8 roundup covers five junior gold explorers drilling adjacent to major mining operations: West Point Gold returned 22.9m at 3.11 g/t from Arizona's Gold Chain Project, GoldMining intercepted 12m at 2.38 g/t with a 1m at 22 g/t kicker at Sao Jorge in Brazil, and Nova Minerals sampled 24.6 g/t Au at Alaska's Estelle project.
